question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Check distinct player count and names again
WITH player_match_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    bbb.match_id,
    bbb.striker AS player_id,
    bbb.team_batting AS team_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bbb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, bbb.team_batting
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, p.player_id, pmr.total_runs
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmr.total_runs >= 100
  AND pmr.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
